issues.on_page: Cash and certificates of deposit 5,812,961; Restricted cash and certificates of deposit 1,642,012
issues.issue: Ending cash is computed (marked) as cash + CDs + restricted cash/CDs because the report prints cash and CDs combined. It includes investments and restricted amounts and equals fund balance. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived, so check whether ending_cash should stay null or hold only the printed combined figure.

issues.on_page: Transfers in (out): General Fund 400,000; Inheritance Tax Fund (400,000); Total Governmental Funds column blank
issues.issue: Statement-level transfers are left null because the Total column prints none, though the fund columns print 400,000 in and out (and nonmajor 37,624 on p17). They net to zero so the roll-forward is unaffected. Same for transfers_out. This is a consistency choice.

The function comes from the fund name (computed 'function: Road/Bridge Fund'). Exhibit D prints this amount only under 'Capital outlay', with no function. Under the 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling (function only when printed) this is defensible but not strictly printed. The Inheritance Tax Fund capital outlay (detail[98]) was left without a function.
